stage_name_zh: 阶段 1：词汇激活、熟词生义破冰与句子主干剖析（Day 1–25）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G021】句子改写核心规范：语义等价、限定守恒与消除四大改写偏差；【G033】去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP001】明确陈述研究目标、问题定义与讨论边界，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 句子改写核心规范：语义等价、限定守恒与消除四大改写偏差
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 句子改写必须在改变句法或词汇结构的同时，100% 保持原句的事实范围、否定、时间、程度和认知确定性，并能准确诊断语法错误、表达不自然、语域不当与语义扭曲。
rules: 限定守恒：原句的 provided that, in this sample, under Gaussian-kernel assumptions, may, arguably 等在改写后必须保留等价限定。
多路径自然改写：支持动词 <-> 派生名词转换、从句 <-> 介词短语转换、主动 <-> 被动焦点转换，提供多个自然可接受版本。
examples:
Source: Missing records account for the discrepancy between the totals.
Rewrite 1: The discrepancy between the totals is attributable to missing records.
Rewrite 2: Missing records explain why the two totals differ.
common_errors: 在改写中偷换概念或将相关关系升级为因果结论。

grammar_instruction.name: 去除“AI 味（Anti-AI-ese）”与过度修辞：用具体机制、指标与实例替代空洞夸张
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 典型 AI 生成文本充斥着空洞的套话与浮夸副词/形容词（如 delve into, testament to, tapestry, underscores the paramount importance, revolutionize, unparalleled, groundbreaking），却缺乏具体技术细节。地道顶会论文（NeurIPS/ICLR/CoRL）与高分雅思/托福/六级写作追求“低修辞密度、高信息密度”：用具体动词、明确指标和真实实例说话。
rules: 删除无实质信息的“清嗓子”套话（Throat-clearing）：少用 *It is worth noting that / It is undeniable that / In the realm of modern artificial intelligence*，直接陈述事实主干。

禁止“只有夸张形容词而不给实例或数据支撑”：不要写 *The model achieves an enormous, unparalleled improvement*，而要写 *The proposed parametrization reduces MSE by 8.4% relative to the seasonal naive baseline on hourly electricity demand*。
优先选用朴素、精准的单音节或核心学术动词（examine, test, compare, constrain, decompose, bound, mitigate）替代故作高深的修辞词。
examples:
AI 腔/空洞夸张：*This groundbreaking paradigm delves into the intricate tapestry of temporal dynamics and achieves unparalleled accuracy.*
地道学术改写：*This model decomposes the series into trend and seasonal components, achieving lower forecasting error than the linear baseline on three benchmarks.*

六级/雅思空洞句：*Technology has an enormous impact on education in many ways.*
地道具体展开：*Asynchronous learning platforms allow part-time students to review lecture recordings at their own pace, reducing scheduling conflicts.*
common_errors: 堆砌 paramount, unprecedented, revolutionize, multifaceted 等宣传式词汇，违反客观学术语域。
只下宏大判断（如 *This method is very efficient*）而不给出具体的计算复杂度、内存占用或延迟数据。

grammar_instruction.name: 主谓一致、数量短语一致与邻近名词干扰排除
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 复杂主语的主谓一致取决于核心名词（Head Noun）而非后置介词短语中的邻近名词。尤其需区分 a number of 与 the number of，以及 along with / accompanied by / as well as 连接的附加成分。
rules: the number of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数；a (large/small) number of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用复数。
主语后接 along with, together with, accompanied by, as well as 时，谓语动词与前面的核心主语保持一致。
the bulk of / a proportion of / a percentage of + 名词作主语时，谓语单复数取决于 of 后的名词是不可数/单数还是复数可数名词。
means, series 单复数同形，谓语由限定词决定（a series of observations was vs two series were）。
examples: The number of completed interviews was recorded separately.
A small number of respondents left this item blank.
The bulk of the evidence comes from observational studies.
One of the surveys was conducted online.
common_errors: 被 of 短语中的复数名词误导：*The analysis of interview responses show（应为 shows）。
把 as well as 误当成 and 改变主语单复数。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 明确陈述研究目标、问题定义与讨论边界
expression_pattern_instruction.template: This study/paper examines [specific problem] and aims to [verb] [measurable objective] within [stated scope].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 开门见山说明研究问题与范围，主语简短，直接用强动词 examines / addresses / investigates。
examples: This paper addresses unequal access to educational resources.
The aim of this paper is to compare annotation rules.
common_errors: 使用冗长空洞的套话开头，或写 *address to a problem。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 界定概念的操作性定义与数学符号表示
expression_pattern_instruction.template: For the purposes of this analysis, we define [term] as [operational criterion], where [symbol] denotes [quantity].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 用于将抽象概念转化为可观测、可复现的操作性指标或符号。
examples: We define the outcome as the number of visits per week.
Here, N denotes the number of observations.
common_errors: 定义含糊或符号指代前后不一致。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：accuracy 是名词，accurate 是形容词。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：likelihood 的形容词相关形式是 likely；注意拼写。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：clarification / purification / unification 为相应名词。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：英美拼写及出版社偏好不同；全文保持一致。

scheduled_review_words.meaning_zh: 思想、学说、体系，或行为、性质
scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：modernist 可为名词或形容词；Marxism 大写。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：词义由语境限定；colourless 的美式拼写为 colorless。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：autocrat指独裁统治者；democrat可指民主制度支持者。democratic、democratise/democratize属于相关词族。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术写作中 abandon an approach 需交代具体实验/校准原因，不等于轻微修改（modify/alter），也不带情感贬义。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The team abandoned the approach after repeated calibration failures.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：只指确实在前出现的内容。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 学术语境与搭配约束：绝对与相对结果可能不同；单位和基数必须明确。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: The absolute difference was reported alongside the relative change.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 一词多词性多义：作形容词指抽象概念，作可数名词指论文摘要（摘要中的指标结论必须与正文实验表严格一致）。 | 词表跨单元多义对比：[V00024 adj.] 抽象的（例：Equity is an abstract concept that requires an operational definition.）；[V00025 n.] 摘要（例：The abstract states the study aim and its principal limitation.）
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Equity is an abstract concept that requires an operational definition.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：前缀；有些词写作一词，如 antibacterial；拼写以词典/格式要求为准。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: Anti-pollution measures may include tighter limits on emissions.

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：biannual 通常一年两次；biennial 每两年一次；bimonthly 有歧义，应写 every two months 或 twice a month。
scheduled_review_words.example_en: A bilingual questionnaire provides the same questions in two languages.
